Hero_Desc_RenewaAwaken:
An elf who recently appeared out of nowhere and started working part-time in the ticket booth of Sprite Kingdom's theater.
Sometimes you can see her being a bit out of it because she's tired from work, but she is kind to everyone.
Album_RenewaAwaken1: With all the frequent Spacetime incidents happening, Renewa has been visiting the Order more often. She used to hesitate and keep her distance, but after much fidgeting, she finally admitted that she wanted to officially join the Order. We held a small welcome party, and Renewa was overjoyed.
Album_RenewaAwaken2: Renewa actively uses the power of another world's Yggdrasil, which she obtained through her Frontier activities. The priestesses seem slightly wary, but they don't really know the true source of Renewa's power.
Album_RenewaAwaken3: Renewa claims to have a secret warehouse somewhere in the Sprite Kingdom. She says it's filled with treasures and important items collected from her journeys across different Spacetimes. She promised to personally guide me there if I ever got interested. I can't help but be a little excited about what kind of treasures might be inside.
Album_RenewaAwaken4: Renewa avoids going near Monatium. She said that if the elves discovered her true identity, it could lead to irreversible consequences. She specifically warned me to be cautious of Monatium's Mayor, Elena.
Album_RenewaAwaken5: Renewa seems to have a lot of questions about why there's only one version of me, the Master, in this dimension. She wondered if another version of me might exist in some parallel world. I asked if she would leave here if she found such a place, and she quickly waved her hands, insisting she would never do that. She claimed she never gives up first.
Album_RenewaAwaken6: If Renewa is from Elias's future, wouldn't that mean she knows what's going to happen? Couldn't she predict events even better than Alice, the phantom who sees the future? When I asked about the future, Renewa, as if expecting the question, firmly replied, "No".
Album_RenewaAwaken7: If Renewa exists in the future, then why isn't she present in this time? She hesitated to speak, but after some thought, she finally confessed. Renewa revealed that at some point in the future, she was born in a test tube. She was a collaborative creation between Elena and Hilde—the pinnacle of Monatium's biotechnology. But she's not a robot, she assured me. Her serious response made the atmosphere slightly awkward, but I guess it also means Renewa now trusts me enough to share her past.
Food_ChefNote_RenewaAwaken_Hate1: She flatly refused to drink it, saying it would be betraying Elena. When I quipped what the big deal would be in betraying an elf, she looked at me with contempt.
Food_ChefNote_RenewaAwaken_Hate2: As soon as the popcorn was served, Renewa immediately got up and started to walk away. I held onto her, trying to get her to stay, but she wriggled off and ran away, saying she didn't want to smell that outside the theater.
Food_ChefNote_RenewaAwaken_Like1: Cutting the block little by little, Renewa neatly ate it all. She seemed touched, saying it tasted like something she ate back home, a place she dearly missed. How fascinating.
Food_ChefNote_RenewaAwaken_Like2: Apparently, this is Elena's favorite tea. Renewa looked more relaxed than usual as she sipped her tea with a big smile on her face.
Food_ChefNote_RenewaAwaken_Like3: She began to eat it as if she was familiar with it, saying she had seen similar foods in other dimensions in Elias. How many of them in Elias has she been to??
Food_ChefNote_RenewaAwaken_Like4: Eating the cake with gusto, she then picked up a large slice, asking if it didn't look like the Elias Frontier. It must have been a joke, as she cringed after saying it.
Food_ChefNote_RenewaAwaken_Like5: She ordered an extra cup of warm water to dissolve the powder so she could drink it. She says it's a good substitute for lemon tea.
Food_ChefNote_RenewaAwaken_Like6: After eating a black bean songpyeon, she suddenly started lecturing on dimensions. She said that there are many dimensions that are like the black bean songpyeon: Perfectly fine on the outside, but are broken in the inside... Is it really that bad?
Food_ChefNote_RenewaAwaken_Like7: She reveled in the sweetness, gushing this was one more reason to protect this world. I hate to say this, but she reminded me of Erpin.
Food_ChefNote_RenewaAwaken_Like8: She said there's a type of sand where its powder tastes like this in a dimension in Elias. When I didn't question anything she said, she was embarrassed, saying it was all a lie.
Food_ChefNote_RenewaAwaken_Like9: Renewa praised the snack, saying it was a great representation of Elias, a place where diverse races gather. She seemed to enjoy tasting each and every one.

LoveLetter_RenewaAwaken: I've spent most of my life wandering from place to place, so I never imagined I'd grow so close to someone. That's why every moment feels more precious, and sometimes a little awkward. I've seen many places across countless versions of Elias, but I find myself holding special expectations for you, Master. I'm somewhat grateful to this timeline for allowing me to meet you. I hope Elias brings you nothing but happiness, Master.
LoveCall_RenewaAwaken:
Hello, Master. It is Renewa. Have you been well?
I am not calling because anything special happened. You simply came to mind.
I do not think I have been able to visit you very often lately because of one thing or another.

Master~ If you have time, how about a movie?
I won these tickets at an event, but I have no friend to watch it with.
Of course, I could go alone, but I think it would be nicer to watch together.
The movie has a high rating and excellent reviews too.
It is about a time traveler and their companion crossing many times and places to solve incidents. Does that not sound rather like you and me? Hehe.
Please do not feel pressured. I hope you will come and simply enjoy yourself. Renewa.
